tools.purpose: Rank executable windows by control-flow density to find the dispatcher a virtualising obfuscator runs the real code through.
tools.expect: per-section totals, densest windows with conditional/call/indirect counts and heuristic reading lines

notes: Read-only. Byte scanning counts opcodes that sit inside immediates, so the numbers rank candidates; they do not census branches. The reading lines are heuristic and never claim an obfuscator identity.
